faqs.question: What is UMA Kumbhaniya's specialty?
faqs.answer: Our main specialties are hot, crispy Kumbhaniya (₹50/100 gm), freshly fried Bhajiya, spiced buttermilk (Chaas ₹20), and artisanal churned ice creams like Special Gotalo and Special Malai (₹30).

faqs.question: Are all food items pure vegetarian?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100% of our items are pure vegetarian, prepared daily with fresh ingredients in clean, traditional kitchen setups.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open every single day (Monday through Sunday) from 04:00 PM to 11:45 PM IST in Babra, Gujarat.

faqs.question: Do you take reservations or advance table bookings?
faqs.answer: No, we do not have a table reservation system. We warmly welcome all walk-in guests and takeaway orders.

faqs.question: How can I order takeaways or contact the restaurant?
faqs.answer: You can call us directly at +91 90991 28700 for takeaway orders or visit us directly at our restaurant in Babra, Gujarat.

faqs.question: Can I buy 1 kg tubs of ice cream for family parties?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer 1 kg family tubs for our specialty flavors starting from ₹290 up to ₹400.

website_content.content: UMA Kumbhaniya is a celebrated culinary landmark in Babra, Gujarat. We bring the warmth of home-cooked Saurashtra food with authentic recipes passed down through generations. Every dish is crafted from fresh, locally sourced ingredients.

All snacks are priced affordably at ₹50 per 100 gm. Beverages like Sosyo, Thums Up, Sprite, Maaza, and Chaas are ₹20 each. Ice creams range from ₹15 for candy sticks up to ₹40 for signature scoops and ₹290–₹400 for 1 kg family tubs. All prices are inclusive of taxes.
UMA Kumbhaniya is located in Babra, Gujarat, India (Coordinates: 21.842125° N, 71.296094° E). Conveniently accessible from major Saurashtra highways.
